description: From observed grades, the grades-to-maximum principle, the genus principle, actuality only insofar as being and excluded middle: some being is maximal in esse (weak IsMaximumIn) and causes esse in every other being having esse. STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING is not a premise. The principle is applied at truth and at esse. The witness is not shown to be maximally true, and the theorem is not attributed to Aquinas, whose text passes through truth. Supplementary closed obligations: actualFork and actualCore are the population-relative split and its exclusion; unboundedGivesAmongActual connects the certified fork's unbounded predicate to that horn; truthBridgeNotEntailed has one Boolean interpretation of the other nonlogical premises and the conclusion with the truth bridge false; withoutActuality and withoutApproach have the conclusion false with the named premise deleted; withoutGrades has the maximum principle and actuality true, grades false and no maximum in esse on an empty carrier. Fixtures concern encoded satisfiability, not metaphysical possibility. Every premise remains open.
